description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Spiteful Squad.
When Spiteful Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
